about: The combined reader's confidence (VSS + Neural, COMBINED_READER.md): SOP-BERT and VSS read the same cut, their requests are paired (layer_common.mjs pairValue, as COMBINE.md); on a pair SOP-BERT's reading is executed, otherwise the one that exists. Two logistic models: 'sop' (SOP-BERT executes: its 23 signals without the act prior, plus agree, agree_share, other_conf) and 'vss' (a VSS request nothing was paired with: VSS's 13 signals without the world prior). Fitted on the fresh2 calibration part out of fold by training/sketch/combine/combined_report.mjs (EXPORT=1); browser code docs/js/combined-confidence.js (training/sketch/test_combined_confidence.mjs checks it). A refit replaces this file only; training/sketch/stamp_models.py gives it a new version.
variant_note: Variant (a) + d2 of confidence3/PLAN.md: neither part reads its prior (act_prior / world_prior are not among the features; the prior tables are kept in the file but unused), chosen for the VSS-BERT column by the selection rule of confidence3/fit3.mjs (the highest calibration out-of-fold cost score) in the refit of 2026-11-03; exported with VARIANT=d2.
protocol: COMBINED_READER.md: calibration part only (368 messages, 808 requested actions); 5 folds by message; percentile maps, prior and L2 (0.01, 0.1, 1, 10 by out-of-fold AUROC) per model; one threshold over all the combined requests, the cost-score optimum (one confident mistake = 10 right answers) on the out-of-fold confidences; inside the folds other_conf came from vss.json's recipe refitted on the training folds. The test part (745 messages) is scored once, never used to choose: its numbers are exploratory. The clean confirmation needs a fresh set (fresh3).
how_to: Per cut: pair the requests (SOP-BERT produced side, VSS gold side of pairValue); agree_share = keys with equal canonical values / union of keys (action, ask excluded; empty union 1), agree = agree_share == 1; other_conf = vss.json's confidence of the paired VSS request on the VSS signals as the demo has them (0 when unpaired). confidence = 1/(1+exp(-(intercept + sum weight * percentile))) of the part that executes, percentile as vss-confidence.js (null -> 1). Execute when confidence >= threshold.

partner.note: other_conf is computed with this file; a refit of vss.json needs a refit of this file

levels_note: Per cut, levels.cost (the default, = threshold) is the threshold that maximises the cost score with one confident mistake = 10 right answers on the calibration part's out-of-fold confidences; cost1, cost2, cost5 (bolder: one mistake = 1, 2 or 5 right answers) and cost20 ('more careful': = 20), chosen the same way. heldout_oof_*: the calibration part at that threshold; test_*: the test part (already read; exploratory).

vss.cut_signals: the SOP-BERT cut head at the unit's edges (cut_start = P(B) of its first word; cut_end = 1 - P(I) of the word after its last, 1 at the end of the text)
